title: From local giants to locality in long-range percolation
summary: We prove the analogue of Schramm's locality conjecture for long-range percolation on transitive graphs of polynomial growth with $α\in (0,2)$. In this setting, we also prove the joint continuity of the percolation probability $θ$ with respect to three parameters: the underlying graph with respect to the local topology, the connectivity kernel, and the percolation parameter $β$ for all values of $β\in \mathbf{R}_+$, including the critical parameter $β_c$.
